metadata.Name: MultiWOZ
metadata.Description: A multilingual task-oriented dialog dataset created by translating MultiWOZ 2.1 development and test portions to Arabic, Chinese, German and Russian.
metadata.Paper Title: Sample Efficient Cross-lingual Transfer for Task-oriented Dialog through Intermediate Specialization
metadata.Abstract: We present a new multilingual task-oriented dialog (TOD) dataset, MultiWOZ-X, created by translating the development and test portions of the English MultiWOZ dataset to four typologically diverse languages: Arabic, Chinese, German, and Russian. We use MultiWOZ-X as a testbed for investigating cross-lingual transfer for two core TOD tasks: Dialog State Tracking (DST) and Response Retrieval (RR). We first establish that zero-shot cross-lingual transfer with state-of-the-art multilingual transformers yields poor performance, especially for DST. We then demonstrate that intermediate conversational specialization of multilingual transformers for the target languages - through masked language modeling, translation language modeling, and response selection pretraining - dramatically improves their zero-shot transfer. Most importantly, we show that such intermediate specialization makes the models much more sample-efficient in few-shot transfer setups: they achieve much stronger performance even with a small number of target-language dialogs.
